verdict.rationale: Framer's built-in AI agent lets users issue natural-language commands (e.g., 'switch to dark mode', 'reorganize homepage flow', 'update typography') that directly modify pages, styling, layout, and CMS content, with changes tracked via branching/version history for safety. This is well documented across first-party docs and even demonstrated with concrete example prompts. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on user reports validating the natural-language agent's reliability and accuracy in practice, since community evidence only covers older non-AI Framer features.
